fields.Medal Notes: ProPublica’s ability to deploy a wide variety of storytelling devices should be a model for digital design teams in engaging readers and inviting participation in tough subject matter. They have created a cohesive body of work defined by visual restraint, a deep understanding of digital as a medium, and a sureness in engineering in their news coverage and products.
